// src/data/moviesData.js

  "ratatouille": {
    id: "ratatouille",
    title: "RATATOUILLE",
    year: "2007",
    age: "13+",
    duration: "1h 51m",
    language: "English",
    director: "Brad Bird",
    synopsis: "Remy, a rat, aspires to become a renowned French chef. However, he fails to realise that people despise rodents and will never enjoy a meal cooked by him.",

    id: "grandma",

    synopsis: "A young man quits his job to take care of his terminally ill grandmother, eyeing her inheritance.",
